title: Household Skills
description: Practical how-tos for shutting off water, clearing drains, fixing a running toilet or leaky faucet, and resetting circuit breakers. Also covers using a fire extinguisher and putting out kitchen fires, patching drywall, sewing buttons and tears, and essential tools.
shortDescription: Shut off water, reset breakers, put out kitchen fires, and fix leaks
